Name: Flaming Tiger Leap
Description: You erupt from the ground like a firework of the College of Hanabi, but thankfully without exploding at your apex. Each creature within a 15-foot-radius, 5-foot-high cylinder centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 5d6 fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of your turn, you gain a flying speed of 120 feet and your movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and your flying speed increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
